decision: Translate the reviewed XPath regex-helper errors only while preparing the effective regex and flags of xsl:analyze-string. Report XTDE1140 for invalid pattern and XTDE1145 for invalid flags, with the standard error QName available to xsl:catch.
boundaries: Evaluate select and regex/flags AVTs outside translation scopes.
Preserve child validation and native-regex construction order.
Do not translate XPath errors raised by AVT evaluation, matching/non-matching child execution or ordinary XPath functions.
Do not change the shared XPath RegexHelper, legacy assertion matcher, profiles, fixtures, exclusions, gate bounds or rules.
No admission of the 579 excluded error cases; the required gate remains 10221/0/4380.
publication: Unpublished development patch 1.81.6; no package publication authorized.
